g.text: Assign one individual, then update the chosen group’s centroid
Read downward. Probabilities use the preceding row; shaded cells show the group receiving the arrival.
An empty group uses the population mean only as a reference. Its first member replaces that reference.
Each later centroid is the mean of actual members. Full groups have zero assignment probability.
